name: Oldenborn (Stormborn Nomad): Ward of the Gale

description.value:
“Storms have learned to lean around you instead of straight through you.”

Ward of the Gale (1/a Soma Break). When you take damage from an attack, hazard, or effect you can see, you may use your reaction to wrap yourself in whirling air and reduce that damage by half until the start of your next turn. The reduction stacks with resistance as normal — apply resistance first, then halve the remainder.

Travel-Hardened. You and any creatures you choose travelling within 30 feet of you have reroll the lowest die on defense checks [TODO(adv-call)] against weather and travel hazards (sand, ash, hail, ice, sudden squalls).
